theorems.name: Submission.idtp_caf_glue_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (S : Set (Euclid P)) (pieces : ι → Set (Euclid P)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid n) (φ h : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (pieces k)) → (∀ k, pieces k ⊆ S) → Pairwise (fun k k' => Disjoint (pieces k) (pieces k')) → μHE[n] (S \ ⋃ k, pieces k) = 0 → volume (F '' (S \ ⋃ k, pieces k)) = 0 → (∀ k, AEMeasurable (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(pieces k ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) volume ∧ ∫⁻ y, (∑' x : ↥(pieces k ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) ∂volume = ∫⁻ x in pieces k, φ x * h x ∂μHE[n]) → AEMeasurable (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) volume ∧ ∫⁻ y, (∑' x : ↥(S ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) ∂volume = ∫⁻ x in S, φ x * h x ∂μHE[n]
